episode.label: Memory Pipeline — Triage Bot, Book of Records Format, Governance Promotion

what: IntegrateWise memory is not written directly by agents, Twins, or session-log utilities. It flows through a worker chain that ends in a Triage Bot, which is the only writer that may shape conversational memory into Book of Records format. Raw AI chats are inputs. Structured institutional knowledge is the output — but only after triage, search indexing, governance review, and human promotion. Twin (Open WebUI) is a read and propose surface, not a canonical writer.

stages.format: episode, decision, learning, commitment, fact, doctrine
OWUI Knowledge collections, Book of Projects / Evolution

triage_flags: governance_state: candidate → later staging on promotion

decisions.rationale: Agents, Ops write-session-log, and Twin must not write session logs or conversational memory directly. All canonical shaping goes through Triage Bot.

decisions.decision: Conversational memory is the staging book
decisions.rationale: Triage writes Book of Records format into conversational memory. It is structured institutional draft, not disposable chat — until aged.

decisions.decision: Search is parallel, not a gate
decisions.rationale: Conversational memory is indexed for search immediately. Promotion to org memory is a separate human-governed path.
Triage Bot may queue. Humans approve. Org memory is never auto-promoted.
Approved org memory becomes files/collections on Twin knowledge surfaces (functional collections, Book of Projects, Evolution). AI workers fetch from those surfaces + search.
Decisions in conversational memory that are not referenced or used for 30 days are aged or deleted. (Refinement of the general 90-day conversational archive rule — decisions age faster.)

Open WebUI gets: knowledge surfaces (org projection), session logs rendered as chats, conversational memory threads, tool servers, and skill definitions mapped to tools. Write path stays in the worker pipeline.

learnings: Book of Records is a write format and a read projection — not a separate memory store. One org_memory table; conversational memory holds triage-shaped drafts.
Authoring order remains last → first when backfilling episodes; pipeline order is always present → governed → permanent.
Current ops code (write-session-log.ts, direct spine POST) is pre-pipeline and must be rerouted to emit triage inputs, not canonical memory.
